decisions.explanation: The new price pair removes the price-gap access problem. A reasonable historical illustration is 677, 117 births in 2024 times the dossier’s 89.11% overall GKV proxy: about 603, 578 infants and EUR 36.04 million. The newer 2025 births with that proxy yield about 583, 000 and EUR 34.8 million. This makes the stated scale plausible, but does not recover the intended cohort year, infant insurance share or scenario inputs. Actual uptake is not required for this expressly hypothetical full-cohort model.

decisions.resolution_blocker: The intended cohort and rounding convention remain unspecified.

decisions.explanation: The actual group includes people whose existing disease can lead to sight loss, not only people already blind or visually impaired. The primary Zi release reports 7.03 million unique GKV patients treated for type 2 diabetes in 2023 under a repeated confirmed-diagnosis definition. Research-institution clinical information explains that diabetes can damage the retina and lead to sight loss, and recommends screening before retinal disease is known. That single within-country disease group supplies a defensible lower bound exceeding seven million. Reconstructing a de-duplicated union of every eye-disease category is unnecessary and would exceed the proposition.
decisions.limits: This supports the broad represented risk group, not seven million blind people or certain future sight loss. Zi routine coding, DDZ broader estimates and RKI GEDA self-report use different ascertainment, dates and populations: RKI gives 6.05 m 2022 while DDZ reports≥9.1 m. No exact uncontested 2026 census or addition of overlapping groups is claimed. The narrow Zi excess above 7 m is routine-diagnosis evidence, not individually validated clinical cases.
decisions.next_step: Resolved at the stated scope. Reopen if genuinely different dated evidence or a broader proposition is assessed.

decisions.explanation: Re-read law and October rationale confirm a continuing ability to refuse credit when curriculum changes destroy equivalence. But the full recorded compound also asserts cessation and preservation of competence. Current section 9(6) is a conditional refusal provision, not automatic cancellation after any material change; a fair reading makes materiality relative to equivalence. The exact September version remains unavailable, and the safeguard alone does not establish empirical unchanged competence. Retain unresolved rather than manufacture a wording error.
decisions.limits: The author’s reasonable equivalence-related reading is retained. No error arises solely because the short phrase says credit ceases rather than spelling out the administrative refusal process.

decisions.explanation: IDW p. 6 says work with professional pronouncements is standard in practice, then proposes their use as examination aids. It does not assert every publication is consulted in every assignment or that such use is a universal statutory duty. Independent BayObLG paragraphs 36–38 expressly recognise IDW pronouncements as accepted and commonly used, while distinguishing their lack of legal-norm status. Together with the professional examination catalogue this supports the ordinary standard-practice proposition. The prior survey demand across all assignments overstated the target.
decisions.limits: The court’s case concerns valuation; it does not establish a measured profession-wide usage percentage, obligation to follow every IDW view, or that current examination aids already permit these publications. Those stronger propositions are not assessed as supported.
decisions.next_step: Resolved at the stated scope. Reopen if genuinely different dated evidence or a broader proposition is assessed.

Its credit-scope description is directly corroborated by the ministry’s public October proposal, which predates that letter, and independently by WPO section 13b’s university-only statutory credit boundary. Article 2 supplies institutional higher-education relief, without a vocational-examination credit category. Requiring authentication of IDW’s separately named September dispatch was an inapplicable additional condition for this BVBC proposition.
decisions.limits: No September dispatch bytes have been authenticated and no claim of their exact identity is made.
